verdict.rationale: First-party docs state the core use case directly. Vercel Sandbox runs untrusted or agent-generated code in isolated Linux microVMs, and it can execute AI agent output, user uploads, or third-party scripts without exposing production systems. Supporting docs add per-agent Linux-user isolation, timeouts, and a self-contained test environment. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation guarantees, and documentation of network egress controls or the depth of the security architecture.
